dedupe_keys.name: hydraulic burst pressure test of type iv composite pressure vessel

description: Caroline Lüders and colleagues at the German Aerospace Center publish geometry, ultrasound and hydraulic-burst measurements for a Type IV composite pressure vessel. Zenodo supplies documented 7z archives free under CC BY 4.0. A PA12 liner and carbon-fibre winding were designed for 200 bar; pressure was recorded at 100 Hz and eighteen strain gauges at 300 Hz, with synchronised ten-hertz derivatives. These measurements can validate deformation and damage simulations for pressure-storage equipment. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. The tested vessel is SN03, while some geometric scans and cut-out measurements come from nominally identical SN01. That distinction limits direct geometry-to-failure comparison. Water pressurisation is not a gas-cycle durability test. Experimental variability, synchronisation and material transfer remain uncertain. No archives were downloaded, finite-element model fitted or actual burst pressure inferred from the design target.
